source_claim: Shueisha's official Dr.STONE fanbook contents identify chapters for Luna Wright and SAI as characters in the series. Shueisha's official Dr.STONE volume 24 synopsis identifies SAI as the brother of Nanami Ryusui, resolving the exact Nanami Sai campaign identity. The fanbook and volume are official publisher publications of the Dr.STONE work.
notes: The S-MANGA official contents page names both fanbook character entries (Luna Wright and SAI); the linked volume-24 publisher page identifies SAI as Ryusui's brother.
